notes.title: Patch 1.2.1
notes.notes: Fixed a bug where completing Book IV removed all previously unlocked songs in the level editor.

notes.title: 1.2 Summer update
notes.notes:
Euclid's Inferno 1.2 adds a new book to the game's library of levels and an endless game mode.

[previewyoutube=vhrPz0n4luc;full][/previewyoutube]

Major changes

 New book: Al-Jabr, packed with eight levels.
 New game mode, survive the Infinite Series by fighting ever increasing waves of enemies.

Level editor

 Configure the initial health, weapons, ammo, and powerups
 Support moving and copying single features
 New enemies and items

Other

 Navigate game menus using the arrow keys or gamepad. Note that the level editor requires the use of a mouse.
 Added settings for modifying gamepad sensibility and aim distance
 Improved level selection menu
 More options and tools in the level editor

notes.title: 1.1 Update - Equinox
notes.notes:
Euclid's Inferno 1.1 comes with lots of improvements to its gameplay and visuals, as well as a new chapter in Euclid's journey through the realm of mathematics.

[previewyoutube=Nxzm3SLzfIU;full][/previewyoutube]

Major Changes


 New book: Dresden Codex, featuring eight levels
 New weapons, enemies and decorative items
 Difficulty settings. Adjusts the damage taken.
 New game mechanic: Rescue the trapped mathematicians and get rewards
 Weapon wheel: Press TAB to quickly switch between weapons


Level Editor


 Levels can now be edited on multiple Z layers
 Configurable grid size
 Several bug fixes


Miscellaneous


 Visual improvements in the GUI, shaders and text drawing
 Improved joystick controls, press left shoulder to switch between cursor and direction mode.
